messages:
Cara H.: Hey team — putting up the new Request Inspector mock for the error analytics page. Trying a compact left 'call chain' column + a wider right detail pane. Thoughts on layout and copy? :eyes:
Ming Zhao: Nice. Can you drop a quick GIF? hard to visualize from the static.
Cara H.: GIF in thread (link). Key changes: 1) call chain is collapsible, 2) stack frames are inline with a small 'copy' affordance, 3) export actions moved into an overflow menu at top-right, 4) correlation ID shown as pill with copy icon.
Devon R.: Quick reaction: the inline stack frames feel dense. Could we show a single-line summary + chevron to expand full stack? For keyboard users, expanding should be reachable with Enter/Space.
Anika S.: Accessibility nit: the copy buttons need descriptive aria-labels. Right now they are just "copy" icons. Please set aria-labels like "Copy stack trace for frame 3" or "Copy correlation ID". Also ensure focus outline is visible at 3:1 contrast.
Cara H.: Good call. I'll add aria-labels. Any thoughts on the export placement? I moved export -> Export as JSON / HAR / CSV into the kebab menu. Is that discoverable enough?
Leo Patel: Kebab is fine for power users, but we should keep a primary "Download trace" CTA in the footer when multi-selecting traces. Overflow-only hides it for users who want to batch export.
Ming Zhao: Agree with Leo. Maybe primary action appears when selection count > 1. Otherwise overflow is ok. Also the kebab copy should say "Download..." instead of just "Export" — more explicit.
Devon R.: Copy tweaks: change "Correlation ID" pill copy tooltip to show a short copy confirmation like "Copied link to clipboard — Open in new tab" and include the permalink. For screen readers, the notification should be announced (aria-live=polite).
Anika S.: Color contrast: the span severity chips (info/warn/error) in the call chain are using brand orange on white — measured 2.8:1. Need to push darker or add strong borders. Also the chevrons in collapsed rows are currently only hint by color, add text for SR like "expand call chain".
Cara H.: Noted — I'll darken the chip colors. UX question: stack snippet truncation — show first 120 chars and "...more" inline or show a "view full stack" modal?
Ming Zhao: Inline expand is faster, modal is better for deep copy/reading. Make inline expand for quick scan and link to full modal for advanced actions (copy all frames, open source link).
Devon R.: Small copy suggestion: change "Copy" to "Copy frame" to reduce ambiguity. Also include an icon-only button for compact rows but ensure it has aria-labels.
Cara H.: Ok. For copy behavior, should we include the file:line anchor in the clipboard (e.g., repo/path.js:123) or the fully qualified source URL?
Leo Patel: Use file:line for local dev readability, and include a separate "Copy permalink" in the modal that gives the full URL. Saves space in quick copy.
jenkins-bot: Deploy preview available at https://staging.redwood.ai/inspector/preview-req-1758765432 — screenshots attached.
Anika S.: Keyboard nav check: tab order currently goes call chain -> details -> kebab. When a stack expand opens, focus should move into the expanded region, and ESC should collapse and return focus to the toggler.
Cara H.: I'll prototype these interactions. Action items: darken chips (Anika), add aria-labels and live region notices (Devon), keep primary download button when multi-select (Leo), inline expand + full modal (Ming). I'll update the mock and post new GIF. :thumbsup:
Ming Zhao: Also log telemetry event names for these interactions so product can measure adoption: inspector.expand_frame, inspector.copy_frame, inspector.download_batch.
Cara H.: Good — I'll add that to the PR description. Thanks all!
